answer.reason: The verses state what Jeroboam II did as king: he restored Israel's border and saved Israel, and he recovered Damascus and Hamath.

clauses.english: restored the coast of Israel from Hamath to the sea of the plain
clauses.quote: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain

clauses.english: saved Israel from affliction by the hand of the LORD
clauses.quote: he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash

clauses.english: recovered Damascus and Hamath for Israel
clauses.quote: how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel

doubts: 2KI 14:25 and 2KI 14:27 may describe the same deliverance as 2KI 14:28, so the second and third clauses could be merged.
1CH 5:17, HOS 1:1, AMO 1:1 only date other events by his reign, so they were left out.
AMO 7:9-11 give Amos's prophecy and Amaziah's accusation, not something Jeroboam did, so they were left out.
